observedTokens.font: Segoe UI, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

outputs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: premium desktop forum interface concept screenshot.
Primary request: refine this nearly-approved Tangent Space dark-theme screen so it belongs visually to the Sylin family at sylin.org. Treat the supplied image as the EDIT TARGET. Preserve the entire working forum layout, density, content, row order, community photography, counts, actions, and all navigation. Keep the full screenshot at its original wide aspect ratio, no device frame or annotations.
Brand reference, verified from the LIVE Sylin homepage: near-black canvas #0F0E12; heading text #F4F4F5; body text #C9C9D1; Segoe UI/system sans serif; elegant light-weight page headings (site uses weight 300); small spaced uppercase section labels; finely drawn quiet borders; warm amber primary buttons #FBBF24 with dark #18181B text and 6px corners. The website combines restrained dark surfaces with playful warm imagery. Translate that visual language into a dense forum. This is shared visual design, not a homepage copy.
Apply these changes consistently:
- Replace the purple/plum cast in application surfaces with almost-neutral ink black #0F0E12, subtly lighter content #151419 and controls #1D1B22. Fine borders approximately #302E36; no broad gradient or vignette.
- Replace lavender application accents with restrained warm amber. Use clear #FBBF24 for the primary action and active-tab underline. Understated supporting link color is light sand/gold #D9C48C. Ordinary Topic/Tangent titles remain near-white; a hovered title alone may be pale gold and underlined. Avoid a screen full of bright yellow links.
- Sidebar active item has a very faint warm tint, off-white label, and a small amber selection indicator. Any hovered Topic row is barely warm charcoal. No yellow outlines around rows. Counts, body copy, authors and timestamps remain legible neutral gray/off-white, never gold for no reason.
- Page-level headings such as Tangents and Night Garden become lighter, elegant 300-400 weight. Keep community and Topic row titles at sturdy 500-600 weight for quick scanning. Use clean Segoe UI-like typography and modestly letterspaced uppercase tiny section labels where they already exist. Do not make all text thin or uppercase.
- Buttons follow Sylin's understated 6px corners and clear fill/border hierarchy. Main filled action warm amber with DARK text/icon. Secondary actions dark fill, fine gray border, warm off-white label.
- Community photographs retain exactly their natural color, crops and subjects, as do human portraits. Warm conservatory, workbench and coast images stay recognizable and supply most visual richness. No new illustrations.
- Lumen keeps the same simple neutral-dark circular "L" avatar in every appearance, with a quiet neutral "Agent" badge. Never replace it with a robot or human.
Keep the header name and original small Tangent Space symbol, its silhouette and product identity intact. No extra 'by Sylin' badge, no replacement lightbulb mascot, no added slogans, hero, pixel-art decorations, marketing cards, stars, glow, textures, neon, or glass effects. Do not add UI controls or change terminology.
Goal: the inviting, useful Tangent forum the user already likes, with Sylin's confident ink-and-amber restraint. A coherent sibling product, not merely a yellow recoloring. Exact clean text, sharp icons and reliable alignment.
SCREEN-SPECIFIC invariants: Tangent directory with ALL FOUR broad horizontal community rows: Night Garden (24 Topics /186 Posts), The Workshop (18/142), Far Horizons (12/87), Common Ground (0/0). Keep their purpose descriptions, Recent Topics links, latest Topic titles/authors/timestamps/excerpts and the empty-community action. Preserve header/sidebar/search, All Tangents/Yours tabs, Recently active sort, and Create a Tangent action. Keep the three subtle colored latest-activity dividers for community distinction but mute them so amber stays the brand action color. Do not replace summary rows with tiles. Keep all four rows visible. Light page heading, confident community titles, readable neutral excerpts, subtle sand-colored links.
